## Record Creator (Workflow 9)
POST /finance-create { tab, values }. Validates the tab + value count, then inserts the row into the matching Postgres table. 400 + error list on invalid input or duplicate key — nothing is written.

Transactions still use Workflow 2 (transaction-logger).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "a record with that key already exists" }) }}
